invariants: category.name must be unique across all categories
category.monthly_budget must be non-negative if provided (stored as cents)
category.icon must be a string or None
expense.expense_date must be in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) and valid
expense.category_id must reference an existing category
budget.category_id must reference an existing category
budget.month must be in 'YYYY-MM' format and valid
budget.unique constraint applies to (category_id, month) across all budgets
expense_date must be <= current date when adding an expense
no duplicate expenses for the same category, amount, and date in a month (if recurring)
expense amount cannot exceed budget limit for its category in the month it was recorded
